# Evochora @TAG@

The files of this record are the release @TAG@ of Evochora, as it is published in its [GitHub repository](https://github.com/evochora/evochora).

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `evochora-@TAG@-linux-x64.tar.gz` | Linux on x64 |
| `evochora-@TAG@-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64 |
| `evochora-@TAG@-macos-aarch64.tar.gz` | macOS on Apple silicon |
| `evochora-@TAG@-windows-x64.zip` | Windows on x64 |
| `evochora-@TAG@-requires-java.zip` | all four systems, needs your own Java |
| `evochora-@TAG@-sources.tar` | the source code of this release |

To use Evochora, download the archive for your system, unpack it and start it as the [Quick Start](https://github.com/evochora/evochora/blob/@TAG@/README.md#quick-start) describes.
